lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense cluster of circular high-luminance pixels is arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, extending along the mid-lateral flank toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a structured lattice pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity highlights on the dorsal-facing edges to low-intensity shadows on the ventral-facing edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated along the lower two-thirds of the fin's macro-mask silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white linear scar is visible on the dorsal-lateral surface above the fourth and fifth gill slits; a distinct notch is present on the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras (Echeneidae) are attached to the ventral and lateral regions of the flank.
